proposal.summary: Roxy-WI before 6.1.1.0 allows remote execution of system commands via subprocess_execute in /app/options.py because inputs from users are not processed; version 6.1.1.0 patches the issue.
proposal.cwe_quote: the system command can be run remotely via the subprocess_execute function without processing the inputs received from the user in the /app/options.py file.
